Best first. The engine takes the highest one that is plugged in — so a rehearsal interface above the built-in output needs nothing said twice. Drag to reorder, or move a selected row with ↑ and ↓. A row in red is ranked but not connected: it holds its place until you say otherwise.

    What the engine found installed. Rescanning asks it to walk the plugin folders again — it can take a while, and it happens inside the engine.

      What this one engine is holding, and for whom — one row per app driving it. Drop throws away whatever that app had loaded; it is not told, and will simply find an empty project. Under each session are the plugins whose own editor can be opened, on the engine's screen.

        Where this machine can copy a playlist to, from the médiathèque's Synchroniser button: a file:// folder — a stick, a local folder, or a network share this machine has mounted. Songs are written as [artiste]/[album]/[titre]; nothing is ever deleted.

          The st0 instances this engine is connected to. Each one lists this engine in its picker, and reaches it through a tunnel this machine opens. None is assumed: add one by its address.

            Only add an instance you trust: it receives this engine's access token, and drives this engine and its copies of that instance's files. The address is checked first — one that is not a st0 instance is refused.

              This engine was started by another supervisor. It can be neither stopped nor restarted from here.
